Description:
This business hotel is situated close to many areas of interest such as the Guangzhou Exhibition Centre, Baiyun Mountain and various business and retail centres. The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the train station with metro links and is not far from the motorway exit, providing direct access to Guangzhou's transport network. The hotel is also only 15 minutes from Guangzhou's new airport.

The air-conditioned hotel has 231 rooms and a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, currency exchange facilities, cloakroom, lift access and hotel safe. Business guests may want to take advantage of the spacious conference centre with room for 10-500 people, the exhibition space and modern meeting facilities, not forgetting the hotel's truly dedicated and experienced events team who are happy to do all they can to assist with the planning of any event. The hotel also houses a café, restaurant, bar, nightclub, hairdressing salon, casino and TV lounge for guests to enjoy during their leisure time. The hotel also provides WLAN Internet access, both room and laundry services, as well as a car park and garage.

The hotel rooms offer sumptuous furnishings and impeccable decoration. Each room has an en suite bathroom with shower, bathtub and hairdryer. In the interest of comfort and practicality, the rooms are also equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, radio, Internet access and a minibar. Almost all rooms are roughly 32 m² in size, stylish and elegantly furnished with a double or king-size bed, air conditioning, heating, iron and ironing board, tea and coffee making facilities and a safety deposite box.

There is a large well-maintained swimming pool within the hotel grounds where parasols are available. Guests can also make use of the beauty salon and spa centre, which offers massage treatments. A sauna and a gym feature, whilst a night club with karaoke facilities provides for evening entertainment.

Renovated in 2011, the Sheraton Grand Guangzhou Huadu Resort guarantees guests a pleasant stay whether in Guangzhou for business or pleasure. En suite bathrooms have a bathtub and soft bathrobes.

This property provides 7 multi-functional rooms and a 443-square-metre banquet room that can hold up to 350 people. A childrens games club and a  24-hour business centre can also be found at this property. Guests can work out in the well equiped fitness centre, or enjoy the extra large outdoor hot tub surrounded by all the greenery of mountains and lakes.

There are 6 restaurants and lounges altogether at this hotel. Overlooking the lake and mountains, Meet serves Western cuisine. Yang serves fine Chinese dishes. Cocktails and live music are offered at the Lobby Lounge. The hotel kitchens use fresh produce from the farm on the mountain. Bar is closed from Thu 29 Aug 2019 until Thu 31 Dec 2020

Description:
This city hotel is located on the well-known Changdi Road, a vibrant commercial and financial district facing the picturesque Pearl River. It is accessible from both Guangzhou Railway Station, approximately 1.5 km away, and Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport.

This 360-room, air-conditioned hotel features newly refurbished facilities, including a fully equipped business centre, conference facilities and restaurants. The hotel also has a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out, a cloakroom, lift access and safe. Guests can enjoy a meal or a drink in the hotel café, restaurant or bar and also take advantage of the hotel's own hairdressing salon, WLAN Internet access, room and laundry services and car park. The friendly service team is on hand to ensure that every guest's needs are met.

The rooms come with an en suite bathroom with shower and bathtub, as well as a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy satellite TV, radio, direct dial telephone with personal voicemail, Internet access, minibar and tea and coffee making facilities. Each room also has a safe, individually regulated air conditioning units, central heating and either a double or a king-size bed. In the interests of comfort and practicality, the rooms come with in-house movies, complimentary toiletries, writing desk and iron/ironing board (selected rooms). Inter-connecting rooms and non-smoking rooms are available upon request, as are cots.

Guests can relax with a game of table tennis or enjoy the massage treatments, which the hotel offers.

The hotel restaurant, which is comprised of an elegant dining hall and 2 private rooms, has a seating capacity of 280. The restaurant specialises in modern Cantonese dishes and entices guests with its range of delectable seafood and healthy soups. The restaurant serves a continental breakfast, lunch and dinner as a buffet, as well as offering set menu options for lunch and dinner.
